summary_1line: After Skanda’s victory is praised and his many names recited, the narrative shifts to Satyabhama asking Draupadi how she maintains harmony with the Pandava husbands.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra embraces the radiant Skanda on the battlefield while the assembled gods look on after the defeat of the Danavas.
In a forest hermitage, Draupadi and Satyabhama sit together laughing and speaking privately after a long separation.
Draupadi stands respectfully serving the five Pandavas while the royal household bustles with attendants and golden vessels.
